questions.prompt: How many poles does a magnet have?
What happens when a magnet is held near glass?
What is the big idea of Magnets?
choices: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.
Only a magnet has two poles.
Only magnets do not attract wood.
questions.answer: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.
questions.rationale: A magnet has two poles. Magnets do not attract wood. Matching poles push apart. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.

Page 1 gives the fact without "only". The other pages give different facts, so this choice is too small to be the whole book's big idea.
